title: Prescriptions Terms: Fill History Amount on Declined Controlled Balances
content:
A patient who fills a Kestrel Prescriptions record in the Schedule V Controlled Prescription, Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription or Schedule II Controlled Prescription class regularly receives the controlled history amount when declining an owed balance on it.

## Terms

The controlled history amount counts the original fills and refills dispensed on the prescription in the last 12 months:

- **four or more** add **0.25**;
- **two or three** add **0.10**;
- **fewer** add nothing.

The amount is added to the controlled decline credit.

## Examples (hypothetical)

| Original fills and refills in the last 12 months | Amount added |
|---|---|
| 5 | 0.25 |
| 4 | 0.25 |
| 3 | 0.10 |
| 2 | 0.10 |
| 1 | nothing |

Balance completions and corrected remakes are neither original fills nor refills and are not counted.
